title: Operational ledger benchmark
root_cause: The ledger is a large hot workload, but migration decisions lack repeatable live-size latency, I/O, memory, recovery, lock, concurrency, rebuild, and certification-attribution budgets.
source_requirement: Benchmark current live ledger before finalizing the custody-preserving migration design.
implementation_steps: Measure append p50/p95/p99 and bytes read/written.
Measure decode/verify, peak memory, recovery, locking, concurrent writers, rebuild, and certification attribution.
Preserve exact environment and ledger identity in receipt.
negative_cases: Archive-size synthetic used instead of live size.
focused_tests: Repeatable bounded ledger benchmark and adversarial recovery tests.
affected_tests: Operational ledger, work admission, release preflight tests.
evidence_required: Raw samples, percentiles, I/O counters, memory peak, recovery/concurrency results, environment, and budgets.
rollback: Benchmark is read/disposable-write only; remove temporary copies and retain receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Every mandated metric has a reproducible live-size result.
Budget pass/fail is explicit and no custody guarantee is weakened.
